title: Who held the appanage?
hook: Does a shared dynasty tell us who held each city?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.
doesNotKnow: Shaybanid/Janid regional administration and city affiliations

objective: Shaybanid/Janid regional administration and city affiliations

claims.text: Iranica describes Samarkand’s joint allocation and later succession separately from Balkh’s conquest into a different appanage and later role as an heir’s seat. Royal male kin, seniority and substantial appanage power define the governing mechanism. A shared dynasty does not make these allocations identical, establish unchanged autonomy across 1500–1700 or represent all inhabitants’ consent.
